newsitem.title: UK: Saudi fund raises $250 mln from foreign investors.
newsitem.headline: Saudi fund raises $250 mln from foreign investors.

text.p: The Saudi Arabia Investment Fund Limited has raised $250 million via a share placement which allows international investors their first access to the Saudi share market, ING Barings said on Friday as international placing agent.
SAIF's investment objective was to acquire a diversified portfolio, principally of equity securities traded on the Saudi stock market, ING said in a statement.
ING said it expected SAIF shares, of which 25 million were issued, to begin trading in London today.
Saudi American Bank, which will be the investment manager, was the domestic placing agent.
SAMBA's chief executive officer Robert Eichfield said he was "confident that this will have a positive effect on the development of the capital markets in Saudi Arabia".
At the end of June some 70 stocks were traded on the Saudi stock market whose capitalisation was $48 billion, ING said. Daily turnover was around $40 million in the first half.
